A destination management career built over three decades, now extending into hospitality, dining and community welfare across Sri Lanka.

Crystal Holidays was established with a presence spanning three decades, growing into one of Sri Lanka's leading tour operators — serving travellers from Europe, Far East Asia, South Asia, Australia, the USA and, more recently, the Maldives with tailor-made holiday arrangements and personalised service.

Under Mr. Hettiarachchi's direction, the group has grown from a single travel agency into a portfolio spanning tour operations, villa accommodation, hotel partnerships and, most recently, Italian dining and hospitality with Mama Roma.

Westend Hotels (Pvt) Ltd

Modern city stays in Mount Lavinia

Westend Hotels is part of the Crystal Group's hospitality portfolio, offering a convenient Colombo stay close to Mount Lavinia's coastline, city connections and everyday essentials.

The property combines practical rooms, easy access and a central location for leisure travellers, business guests and visitors exploring Colombo.

Meet the Managing Director

Wansa Hettiarachchi leads Crystal Holidays, a destination management company established with three decades of experience in Sri Lanka's travel industry.

Crystal Holidays has grown into one of Sri Lanka's leading destination management companies, serving travellers from Europe, Far East Asia, South Asia, Australia, the USA and the Maldives with unique, professional and tailor-made travel arrangements.

With dedicated personalised service and competitive prices, the company offers carefully selected holiday packages for discerning travellers who want to make the most of their time and travel investment in Sri Lanka.

Crystal Villas (Pvt) Ltd

Crystal Villa — Weligama

Set on the Galle–Matara Road at Pelena, Weligama, Crystal Villa sits directly on the beachfront, its palm-shaded lawn running straight down to the sand — the south coast's easiest bay for surfing and swimming, with Mirissa Beach a short drive further on.

The property is built around two swimming pools and sun terraces overlooking the ocean, with rooms including a Deluxe Chalet and a Superior Triple Room. Guests have free WiFi, free self-parking and luggage storage, with the beach, cafés and surf schools of Weligama all within walking distance.

Beachfront property Two swimming pools Free parking & WiFi Mirissa Beach — 6 min drive
Mama Roma — Weligama

Where it all began, on the coast

Mama Roma's first home was in the beautiful coastal town of Weligama, where wood-fired pizzas and handmade Italian favourites were served up alongside some of the most stunning views on Sri Lanka's south coast.

It became a place where great food, good company and the relaxed spirit of the coast came together — the same spirit that now carries through to the new restaurant on Galle Road, Mount Lavinia.

Weligama, South Coast Wood-fired pizza Ocean views +94 770 114 242
Community & Education

Indian Ocean Disaster Relief — Borala, Weligama

Indian Ocean Disaster Relief (IODR) was founded in the aftermath of the 2004 Boxing Day tsunami to support the children of Sri Lanka's south coast. Its Weligama Community, Welfare and Education Centre has since grown into a lasting fixture of the Borala neighbourhood — offering free daily study support, meals and welfare care to local children.

Wansa Hettiarachchi serves as trustee of the Borala, Weligama branch, which today supports the free education of over 200 children.

200+ children supported Free daily study support Borala, Weligama

From Weligama to Mount Lavinia

Mama Roma's journey
The beginning

Weligama

Mama Roma began on Sri Lanka's south coast, bringing wood-fired pizza and handmade Italian favourites to Weligama, paired with the town's relaxed coastal atmosphere.

The new chapter

Mount Lavinia — Galle Road

Mama Roma has now opened its new home on Galle Road, Mount Lavinia, as Mama Roma — Authentic Italian Restaurant, Café & Sports Bar: five floors of dining, coffee, sport and private celebration, built on the same promise of authentic Italian taste, fresh ingredients and passion in every dish.
